content.name: Uncanny Metabolism
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52}, you can regain all expended Focus Points. When you do so, roll your Martial Arts die, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to your Monk level plus the number rolled.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
